title: Thoughts to Keep in Mind: The Covenant

footnotes.text: Russell M. Nelson, “Drawing the Power of Jesus Christ into Our Lives,”EnsignorLiahona,May 2017, 41. President Linda K. Burton said: “Making and keeping covenants means choosing to bind ourselves to our Father in Heaven and Jesus Christ. It is committing to follow the Savior” (“The Power, Joy, and Love of Covenant Keeping,”EnsignorLiahona,Nov. 2013, 111).
